nodes.name: When executed by core workflow
nodes.notes: Accepts cluster_id from the core or manual recovery workflow.

parameters.query: SELECT c.id AS cluster_id, c.ticket_count, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('ticket_id', t.id, 'text', t.raw_text) ORDER BY ct.assigned_at) AS tickets FROM ticket_cluster.clusters c JOIN ticket_cluster.cluster_tickets ct ON ct.cluster_id = c.id JOIN ticket_cluster.tickets t ON t.id = ct.ticket_id WHERE c.id = $1::uuid GROUP BY c.id, c.ticket_count;

parameters.jsCode: const c=$json;if(!c.cluster_id||!Array.isArray(c.tickets)||c.tickets.length<3)throw new Error('Cluster lacks reviewable evidence');const primary='REPLACE_WITH_OPENROUTER_VERIFICATION_MODEL',gemini='gemini-2.5-flash';const instructions='Return JSON only: verdict (verified|rejected|needs_review), confidence (0..1), root_cause, evidence_ticket_ids using only supplied UUIDs, rationale. Verify one underlying root cause; never invent evidence.';const schema={type:'OBJECT',properties:{verdict:{type:'STRING',enum:['verified','rejected','needs_review']},confidence:{type:'NUMBER'},root_cause:{type:'STRING'},evidence_ticket_ids:{type:'ARRAY',items:{type:'STRING'}},rationale:{type:'STRING'}},required:['verdict','confidence','root_cause','evidence_ticket_ids','rationale']};return[{json:{...c,primary,gemini,request:{model:primary,response_format:{type:'json_object'},messages:[{role:'system',content:instructions},{role:'user',content:JSON.stringify({tickets:c.tickets})}]},geminiRequest:{systemInstruction:{parts:[{text:instructions}]},contents:[{role:'user',parts:[{text:JSON.stringify({tickets:c.tickets})}]}],generationConfig:{temperature:0,responseMimeType:'application/json',responseJsonSchema:schema}}}}];

const s=$('Build verification requests').item.json,r=$json,raw=r?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content,ids=new Set(s.tickets.map(t=>t.ticket_id));let v;try{v=JSON.parse(raw??'')}catch{}const valid=x=>['verified','rejected','needs_review'].includes(x?.verdict)&&Number.isFinite(x?.confidence)&&x.confidence>=0&&x.confidence<=1&&typeof x.root_cause==='string'&&Array.isArray(x.evidence_ticket_ids)&&x.evidence_ticket_ids.every(id=>ids.has(id))&&typeof x.rationale==='string';return[{json:valid(v)?{...s,fallback:false,verification:v,verification_model:s.primary,response:{provider:'openrouter',body:r}}:{...s,fallback:true,primaryFailure:{provider:'openrouter',status:r?.error?.code??r?.statusCode??null,message:r?.error?.message??r?.message??'Missing or invalid structured response',body:r}}}];

nodes.name: Verify root cause with Gemini fallback
nodes.notes: Attach the same Header Auth credential as Embed ticket with Gemini: x-goog-api-key = GEMINI_API_KEY.

parameters.jsCode: const s=$('Route OpenRouter verification response').item.json,r=$json,raw=r?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.map(p=>p.text??'').join('')??'',ids=new Set(s.tickets.map(t=>t.ticket_id));let v;try{v=JSON.parse(raw)}catch{}const valid=x=>['verified','rejected','needs_review'].includes(x?.verdict)&&Number.isFinite(x?.confidence)&&x.confidence>=0&&x.confidence<=1&&typeof x.root_cause==='string'&&Array.isArray(x.evidence_ticket_ids)&&x.evidence_ticket_ids.every(id=>ids.has(id))&&typeof x.rationale==='string';if(valid(v))return[{json:{...s,verification:v,verification_model:s.gemini,response:{primary:s.primaryFailure,fallback:{provider:'gemini',body:r}}}}];return[{json:{...s,verification:{verdict:'needs_review',confidence:0,root_cause:'Verification providers unavailable',evidence_ticket_ids:[],rationale:'OpenRouter and Gemini did not return a valid structured response.'},verification_model:s.gemini,response:{primary:s.primaryFailure,fallback:{provider:'gemini',body:r}},provider_failure:true}}];

nodes.name: Draft report with Gemini fallback
nodes.notes: Attach the same Gemini Header Auth credential as the verification fallback.

parameters.jsCode: const s=$('Route OpenRouter report response').item.json,r=$json,raw=r?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.map(p=>p.text??'').join('')??'';let report;try{report=JSON.parse(raw)}catch{}const valid=x=>x&&['summary','suspected_root_cause','impact','evidence','recommended_next_step'].every(k=>x[k]!==undefined&&x[k]!==null&&x[k]!=='');if(!valid(report))throw new Error('Both report providers failed: '+(r?.error?.message??r?.message??'Gemini returned invalid structured report JSON'));const canonicalEvidence=s.tickets.map(t=>({ticket_id:t.ticket_id,description:t.text}));return[{json:{...s,report:{...report,evidence:canonicalEvidence},report_model:s.gemini}}];
